title: Ro ro ke madeene walo se
body:
Ro ro ke madeene walo se, sab haal saunaya zainab ne
Jo ajre risaalat me paaya, wo neel dikhaaya zainab ne
Ji bhar ke na rone paayi thi , jab shaam ke zindaa'n se chooti
Is tarah madeene me royi, dunya ko rulaaya zainab ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Atthara baras ke paale ko , cheh maah ke bhole bhaale ko
Bhai ko bachaane ki qaatir , haatho'n se ga'waaya zainab ne
Ye koun zayeefa baithi hai, pehchaan na paaye abdullah
Kuch jaan na paaye abdullah, Yu'n sog manaaya zainab ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Fitrat ko badalne ki qaatir, Baatil ko palatne ki qaatir
Dunya ko badalne ki qaatir, Beto'n ko badhaaya zainab ne
